features.title: First recorded prediction from live prices and memory, resolved by code
criteria: Prices are stored every 5 minutes and survive a process restart
No prediction can be recorded when the asset's latest price is older than 15 minutes
A prediction cannot be recorded without probability, condition, horizon and hypothesis link
A recorded prediction cannot be updated or deleted through the agent's tools
At its horizon, code resolves the prediction from stored prices and computes its Brier score
Resolution appends one evidence row to the linked hypothesis and updates its computed confidence
/statut shows open and resolved predictions in French

features.title: Sonni already knows things: prior hypotheses tested by code on daily history
criteria: Daily candles for followed assets are fetched from Kraken, skip the unfinished day, survive a restart and are refreshed in place
A hypothesis can carry a test rule; invalid rules are refused with a message the model can act on
Code evaluates each rule on stored history and records cases, hits, rate, base rate, z and verdict, append-only
Historical tests rerun only when new days of data arrive, and never change forward confidence
propose_hypothesis tests a rule at once and returns the verdict; origin is prior during the intake, observation after, with a daily limit
Once history is stored, the intake runs on the stronger model, counts an attempt only on a paid turn, and stops at 30 prior hypotheses or 3 attempts
The memory pack and /intuitions show historical verdicts next to forward evidence, in French for the owner
Tests make no network or paid inference calls

features.title: Sonni knows itself: versioned identity, append-only journal, lessons with evidence, self-report computed by code
criteria: The identity starts from a code-written seed; the model may revise it at most once per UTC day, keeping the anchor words; every version is kept and the owner can read them
A post-mortem can only be written for a scored prediction, once; reflections are append-only and capped per day
A lesson needs at least one existing prediction or hypothesis as evidence, is capped per day and in number, and is retired (never deleted) by the model or by the owner's /veto
The self-report (calibration buckets, Brier by asset, horizon and direction, counts, spend) is computed by code and shown in the memory pack and /bilan
After a prediction resolves, the next wake carries the reflection instructions and code marks the reflection done once a paid turn ran
Identity and active lessons sit in the cached part of the system prompt; the rules block with the day's counters is the last, volatile part

features.title: Sonni uses free reader models for reading, never for deciding: headlines and pages become validated observations

features.title: Step 3: the second brain on the owner's PC (assistant by default)
criteria: The second brain's key goes only to the owner's tailnet; without the key or in mode off it is never called; its answers are untrusted data validated by code and it has no tool

A VPS-owned queue with priorities, dedupe keys, validity windows and leases: a PC that stops mid-task loses nothing, the first valid answer wins, Claude never waits, an outage over 2 hours is an incident

Assistant mode (default): the PC reads first among the readers, triages news (shadow wakes, capped), writes situation notes shown at wakes, argues against open positions, gathers post-mortem facts, answers /question by Telegram

Parallel mode scores the second brain's own probabilities against Claude's by code; each answer records the model the PC serves and the evidence (parallel score, delegation gate, confirmation at 50 tasks with under one failure in ten) counts only that model; delegation is refused until 100 are scored within 0.01 of Claude's Brier

On the owner's PC a supervisor runs llama-server on 127.0.0.1 with the key file, restarts it when it stops, pauses on a flag file and reads optional model and options files; sonni/GUIDE-PC.fr.md takes the owner from Windows settings to /cerveau through Tailscale serve, with a grants policy limiting the VPS to that one port

implementation.note: Queue, modes, assistant jobs, parallel scoring, served-model attribution, /cerveau, /question; PC supervisor script and sonni/GUIDE-PC.fr.md (26 steps)

features.title: Step 3: a verified copy of Sonni's memory on the owner's PC each night
criteria: The runtime keeps 7 self-contained daily copies (rollback journal) with no file left beside them after the G7 check; leftovers of older WAL-mode copies are cleaned at the next backup

Each night the VPS exports the newest copy as the sonni user only after reopening it (integrity_check, Sonni's stores present), with its SHA-256, keeping only the newest in the export folder; a damaged or incomplete copy is refused and the previous one stays

The PC fetches only daily-copy names through a read-only, chrooted, key-only SFTP account usable from the tailnet range only, keeps a copy only when its SHA-256 matches, keeps 30 days and logs failures and stale copies

implementation.note: Self-contained backups with a 7-copy rotation that holds; nightly export as sonni with SHA-256; read-only chrooted SFTP from the tailnet; PC pull checks names and SHA-256, keeps 30 days

features.title: Step 4: memory v2 (search, lessons scored when applied, similar past days, summaries)
criteria: search_memory, /memoire and recall use one full-text index of every store, fed incrementally, filtered by asset, period and kind
Words are folded (accents, case, plural) and reach SQLite as quoted terms only; each hit carries its kind, id, date and asset, untrusted kinds marked
Ranking weighs importance and recency, puts the current dossier and identity above older versions and active lessons above retired ones
On the step 4 evaluation set the answer is in the first three hits for 16/16 questions against 11/16 for the old keyword recall; paraphrases are measured (0/3)
Code scores each cited lesson from the outcome and flags one used 6 times that hurt twice as often as it helped: flag in the cached prompt, counts in the pack and /lecons
The pack shows each asset's regime and its five most similar past days, a week apart, only days whose next 7 days are stored, with what followed
Code writes one summary per finished UTC day, ISO week and month with activity, once, with its sources, searchable and labelled in French for the owner
